name: Circuit Lab
about: The layers of ARCHITECTURE.md, bottom first. The core knows the laws and nothing of the page; the kit draws and knows no law; each lab joins the two for one idea; the app finds the labs in their list and lays out the page.

layers.name: core
layers.why: The laws, the converter and the units, pure

layers.name: kit
layers.why: Controls, readouts and circuit symbols every lab draws with

layers.name: labs
layers.why: One idea each: a circuit to play with and its practice

layers.name: app
layers.why: Reads labs.json, lays out the tabs and the theme
